data_fields.name: death_xp_tax_type
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 = percent of next-level exp; 2 = percent of total exp

data_fields.name: pk_mode_penalty_multiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 (killer is a player in pk mode)

data_fields.name: respawn_delay_ms_special_zone
data_fields.donor_constant: 1000 ms (GvG2, battleground, PvP points below zero)

best_idea: A death costs at most one item (each configured entry rolls once and removes at most one eligible item), and an XP tax that is a percent of next-level XP, capped at current XP, is skipped when a consumable insurance item is spent.
decision_why: Keep the take-one entries and the insurance skip, with the roll fixed to once per entry, rates as zone data, and the zeny tax left out until Dom rules on currency.
acceptance: In a PvP zone with one take-one entry at 50% on a non-stackable item in two inventory slots, 2000 simulated deaths lose that item in about 50% of deaths (not 75%), never more than one item per entry per death, and no penalty runs in the Pit.
